title: pack's priced note fires on any cost question, so a question about a non-monetary cost gets a false check: and route split
goal: the priced note fires only on a question that asks for a money amount: a good pack of 'What does Graph throttling cost for me/getMemberGroups in resource units?' carries no priced note, while 'What is the current price of a Microsoft 365 E5 licence?' keeps it

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbfacts;a=kbfacts.pack('What does Graph throttling cost for me/getMemberGroups in resource units?').get('priced');b=kbfacts.pack('What is the current price of a Microsoft 365 E5 licence?').get('priced');print(a,b);sys.exit(0 if not a and b else 1)
